light_evidence: CONFIRMED: "light wavelength composition of 85% red, 15% blue, and 60 umol m-2 s-1 intensity" (OSDR protocol)
reason: Flagship. Only study here with a matched proteome. GeneLab ships raw RSEM counts but no DGE, so PyDESeq2 is run on the 6 flight vs 6 ground shoot samples.

light_evidence: INFERRED: BRIC PDFU canisters have no growth illumination; OSDR protocol mentions only 1-2 h white light to synchronise germination, never a growth photoperiod. Weaker evidence than OSD-321.
reason: Independent sealed-hardware replicate, and the second study with a proteome (soluble + membrane). One matched contrast, unambiguous.

light_evidence: CONFIRMED: "cultivate sterile dark-grown seedlings germinated aboard the ISS for a 14 day period" (OSDR description)
contrast: Log2fc_(Space Flight & Wild Type)v(Ground Control & Wild Type)
reason: Third sealed replicate. Wild-type arm only; the four UPR-mutant arms are left aside as they perturb the very stress response we are measuring.

light_evidence: CONFIRMED: "Light Treatment" is an explicit study factor level and names the contrast
contrast: Log2fc_(Col-0 & Wild Type & Space Flight & Light Treatment)v(Col-0 & Wild Type & Ground Control & Light Treatment)
reason: Intermediate enclosure. Leaves, confirmed by the study description contrasting leaves with root tips.

light_evidence: CONFIRMED: "Dark Treatment" is an explicit study factor level and names the contrast
contrast: Log2fc_(Col-0 & Wild Type & Space Flight & Dark Treatment)v(Col-0 & Wild Type & Ground Control & Dark Treatment)
reason: INTERNAL CONTROL. Same hardware, same plants, no light. Without photosynthesis there is no CO2 drawdown, so the model predicts the carbon-starvation signature should be ABSENT here while present in the light arm.

light_evidence: CONFIRMED: "Plants in the Veggie hardware were exposed to constant light conditions of 100-135 umoles/m2/s PAR" (OSDR protocol). NOTE this is ~2x the PAR of OSD-522.
contrast: Log2fc_(Wild Type & Space Flight & leaf)v(Wild Type & Ground control & leaf)
reason: The vented arm. Explicit leaf tissue and a wild-type contrast; the elp2-5 and met1-7 methylation mutants are left aside.
